metadata.title: feat(oauth): support per-virtual-server client_id in audience validation
metadata.author: kimsehwan96

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #4171

---

## 📝 Summary
Add per-virtual-server `client_id` field in `oauth_config` that is independently appended to the expected audience list during OAuth token verification.

IdPs without RFC 8707 Resource Indicators support (e.g. Authentik) set the access token `aud` claim to the OAuth `client_id` instead of the resource URL. Previously, `oauth_config.resource` and `oauth_config.client_id` were mutually exclusive (`resource or client_id`). Now both are additive, so operators can specify `client_id` alongside `resource` to accommodate non-RFC-8707 IdPs.

---

|---------------------------|-----------------|--------|
| Lint suite                | `make lint`     |    pass    |
| Unit tests                | `make test`     |    pass    |
| Coverage ≥ 80%            | `make coverage` |        |

Deployed a custom build to a production EKS cluster running Authentik as the SSO provider:

1. **Before**: Virtual server with `oauth_config.client_id` absent → Claude.ai custom connector returned `401 Audience doesn't match` (Authentik token `aud` = `client_id`, CF expected `resource URL`)
2. **After**: Set `client_id` via admin UI → Claude.ai connector authenticated successfully, MCP tools loaded and functional
3. Verified that omitting `client_id` preserves existing behavior (resource URL only)

commits.message:
feat(oauth): support per-virtual-server client_id in audience validation

IdPs that do not support RFC 8707 Resource Indicators (e.g. Authentik)
set the access token aud claim to the OAuth client_id rather than the
resource URL. This causes audience verification to fail when APP_DOMAIN
differs from the public-facing domain.

Previously, oauth_config.resource and oauth_config.client_id were
mutually exclusive (resource OR client_id). Now both are additive:
resource extends the audience list, and client_id independently appends
the IdP's client identifier. Operators can set the per-virtual-server
client_id via the admin UI to accommodate non-RFC-8707 IdPs.

- streamablehttp_transport.py: separate resource and client_id handling
- admin.py: parse client_id field in create/edit server forms
- admin.html: add client_id input in create/edit server modals
- servers.js: populate client_id when editing a server
- test_auth.py: 9 new tests for client_id audience extension

Signed-off-by: kimsehwan96 <sktpghks138@gmail.com>
